scope: Host draw attempts and browser callbacks, not GPU execution time or physical scanout
limitations: An absent Host submission is not proof of a slow GPU.
Callbacks inside gaps need the Host guard outcome for causal attribution.
Trace/screenshot events are correlations, not proof that capture caused a gap.
A 30 Hz display has a nominal 33.33 ms refresh period; no timer or counter change can remove it.
Tracing adds overhead; timings are not substituted for earlier untraced results.
Top20 analyzer gaps are not all gaps>50; perHandoff retains every interval in its explicit diagnostic window and samples retain the full submitted-frame sequence.
A Scheduler::RunTask wall interval with little CPU is not measured GPU execution time; neither its overlap nor absence of callbacks proves cause.
No causal claim for83ms/265ms untraced previous runs. A6/A/B/C and cadence/platform/full3123 gates remain open.
